latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of aliyun-qwen-multimodal-embedding skill.
- Supports generation of multimodal embeddings (text, image, video) using Alibaba Cloud Model Studio models for retrieval, search, clustering, or offline vectorization.
- Provides normalized embedding.multimodal interface with customizable model, input types, and output dimensions.
- Includes validation and reproducibility steps, plus guidance for pairing with vector stores.
- Documents exact supported model names and selection guidance.
